page.overview:
Who is Lothíriel?

Lothíriel was a princess of Dol Amroth in Middle-earth, daughter of Prince Imrahil, and later Queen of Rohan.

Lothíriel was the wife of King Éomer of Rohan. Lothíriel was the daughter of Prince Imrahil of Dol Amroth; her mother's name is not known. Lothíriel was born in TA 2999. She had three older brothers: Elphir, Erchirion, and Amrothos. She was Boromir and Faramir's cousin.

Lothíriel married Éomer, King of Rohan, in TA 3021 They had at least one son named Elfwine the Fair, who became the nineteenth King of Rohan on the death of his father in the year 63 of the Fourth Age.

Lothíriel means "flower-garlanded maiden," from the Sindarin words loth ("flower, blossom"), and the element riel ("garlanded maiden"). The latter of the words comes from the root rig ("twine, wreathe"), and the feminine ending -iel.
